value.text: Yes, the HelioSync I10 can charge the Orion E4 through the GridNest W11. The charging power is limited by several factors, including the configured import policy, the available photovoltaic (PV) generation, household load, and the grid limit. In grid-assisted mode, the W11 may request up to its configured 11 kW while the grid supplies any shortfall. In surplus-only mode, charging may be reduced or paused to maintain net import near the configured threshold. Additionally, the Orion E4 has a maximum AC input of 11 kW, which is the upper limit for charging regardless of the wallbox rating.
